digest.component_or_area: plan clarity and P1 readiness gates
propositions: Empty parsed Acceptance Criteria checklist items must be rejected by standalone clarity and plan-review P1 gates
Unresolved sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in active execution sections must trigger clarity failures and P1 blocks when appearing as values or assignments

Sentinel detection must ignore fenced code blocks, inline backtick code, and prose mentions; must suppress matches on same lines containing negation terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without)
A shared plan-structure parser must enforce deterministic clarity floors without altering ticket-type exemptions or legacy compatibility scoring
Cross-surface tests must verify agreement between standalone clarity_check_compute and plan-review p1_readiness_shape on both positive and negative controls
